topic: Database storage and data retrieval optimization
summary_markdown: The conversation focused heavily on optimizing database storage and performance for analytics workloads. Initial discussions covered upgrading temporary disk capacity, suggesting a 100GB io2 volume with 250 iops to boost speed for recalculations (recalc-ch). The team decided to implement a high-performance temp disk using a 100GB gp3 volume with 3000 iops and 750MBps, which was determined to be cost-effective. Furthermore, the strategy for data retention was updated: cold storage volumes were migrated from standard to sc1 class for significant cost savings (from $22/month to $7/volume). Finally, discussions addressed potential connection timeouts when retrieving large datasets over extended periods, suggesting manual exports or increasing socket timeouts.
decisions: Implement a 100GB gp3 temp disk with 3000 iops and 750MBps on the designated node (04).
Migrate cold storage volumes from standard to sc1 class for cost reduction.
action_items: Investigate potential connection timeouts when querying large, historical datasets via data API.
Review and potentially increase socket timeout settings in the IDE.
